svg.title: Accuracy grades ISO 3408-3
svg.text: Accuracy grades of positioning ball screws – ISO 3408-3 / JIS B 1192-3 (example table values – check the standard)
solid = e_p (± travel deviation over l_u), dashed = v_up (travel variation)
e_300 = travel error in any 300 mm
(± 50 µm for C7), no e_p over l_u.
Grade = ground (C0 – C5) or rolled (C7 – C10).
How to read the lead chart (measured on a lead tester / laser, item 5)
actual travel deviation (accent): long wave = e_p / v_up, short wave = v_2π, any 300 mm window = v_300
e_p: allowed ± deviation of the mean travel
from the target T over the useful travel l_u.
v_up: band width of the actual travel (max − min)
over l_u. v_300p: band in any 300 mm.
v_2πp: band in one revolution (10 mm here).
T: a negative target (e.g. −0.03 mm / 1 000) is
ordered when the screw is pre-tensioned (§11).
